units.en: The Vic3 to HoI4 converter is a ⟦0⟧ that takes a Victoria 3 save and generates an HoI4 scenario from it. It can be downloaded from this forum thread. It is compatible with outputs from other converters, allowing the player to play a continuous ⟦1⟧ from Imperator to HoI4. This is a continuation of the ⟦2⟧.

Here is a general list of Converter capabilities and conversion mechanic explanations. For more information feel free to ask for clarifications on forums or take a peek at the code. ⟦0⟧ The converter includes a ⟦1⟧ folder that contains all data files with rules it uses during conversion. These files are there for a reason - so the user can view them and modify them according to specific needs. Do not be shy to hack away and change them so the conversion fits expected goals.
Victoria 3, latest version. DLCs are optional.
Hearts of Iron 4, latest version. DLCs are optional.
Converter will produce a Hearts of Iron 4 mod.
On Windows, and using the front-end, the mod will be copied to Hoi4 mod/ directory.
Without front-end (running the converter manually) or on other OS-es, mod will be exported to converter's output/ folder, and will have to be moved by user.
Conversion-date bookmarks can be quite early, chaining converters from CK2 onward, one can play a 769 game in Hoi4 engine, though aside for the novelty that is a horrible idea.
Converting earlier than 1936 will cause penalties in manpower levels, industrial footprint, and converted technologies, and is not recommended.
Countries are currently a blank-slate conversion and only keep their name, color, and land. This will be improved soon.
Technologies are converted according to configurables/tech_mappings.txt.
States are converted from Vic3's states, but islands and other disconnected provinces may be split into their own states. Wastelands are split into separate states.
Resources are distributed according to configurables/resources.txt.
Victory points are assigned to each of the significant provinces defined by Vic3. The point values are determined by the type of significant province. This will be changed soon.
Manpower is simply the Vic3 population.

Industry is converted as one factory per 100,000 employed workers. If there are more than twelve factories in a state, they will be given to the owner's next state so that they don't go beyond HoI4's maximum.
The smallest state category that can handle the number of converted factories is assigned.
The converter is designed to work with Vic3 mods, including games converted from EU4 to Vic3. Other mods may also work.
There may be future support for combining the converter's output with other HoI4 mods. But this will be a low priority, and currently this is completely untested.

Q: I used a mod, will the converter work with it? A: It depends on what the mod changed. Your best bet is to simply try (and let us know how it went). As far as we can tell, it does work well with games converted from EU4.
Q: The converter says "Saving Configuration: Failed!" How do I fix it? A: Disable your antivirus or allowlist the converter.
If you wish to help with development, there are plenty of ways to do so. Descriptions of needs follow.
We can always use more programmers. The converter itself is in C++, and the tools that go with it are in C# and C++.

Province mappings always need more work. The order that HoI4 provinces are linked make a difference for where things like VPs end up, so if you can update province mappings (and send me the file) for areas you know, that'd be helpful.

Catching bugs and oddities earlier means they get fixed earlier. I try to release test versions of the converter on the forum for testing, so running those and looking things over is helpful. And if you have professional experience in testing, well, I'm sure we could be doing things far better. Tell me how!

We can always use help figuring out how things work, and how we can do them better. If you know how to mod HoI4, we can use your help figuring it out. As well, there's always more room for flavor events, decisions, and the like.
We can always handle more discussion on how things are converted over on the forum thread. And your encouragement helps more than you know.

The Road to 56 is a vanilla-like major overhaul mod for Hearts of Iron IV, overhauling and expanding its content as late as 1956.
New focus trees or improvements for almost all starting nations, and overhauls of vanilla ones.
Technologies to do until as late as 1959 with a new dedicated specialization and mechanization tab.
New governmental laws in the country tab.
Expanded game rules including switching between base game and Road to 56 trees, and player control over peace conferences.
Many behind the curtains bug-fixes and improvements to things like the AI compared to the base game.
Dedicated Art in the style of Vanilla, ranging from portraits, focuses, and spirits to all sorts of different icons.
Road to 56 has been authored by many people, especially as its Github is public. Current notable people:

All of our developers and contributors can be found in our Official Discord Server and if you ever wish to support The Road to 56 Project to unleash its best potential, you can always become a Patreon!

We are all working alone on separate projects but we always count on our fellow team members to help us out when we are in dire need of help or inspiration. All the features are always checked by a different member and run through multiple balance factors so that we ensure each addition to the mod is as balanced as possible.
The mod also includes custom Achievements that are currently being developed. Achievements such as:
Banana America - As Fascist Honduras puppet the USA
It's 1527 All Over Again - This one I am really not sure of. How do we represent Rome being sacked in an icon? Habsburgs
That's not what I meant by Anschluss - As Austria, refuse Anschluss and capitulate Germany.
Hibernia Rules the Waves - As Ireland build a battleship and ensure the UK has no capital ships.
A Truly International City - As Danzig, control a state on every continent.
Anyone Want Some Freedom? - As the USA, control all oil-producing states in the Middle East.
You Canute do that! - As Denmark, restore the North Sea Empire.
Bringing the Revolution Home - Win the German civil war as the communists, and don't ally with the Soviet Union.
Finlands Sak är Vår - As Sweden, join Finland in the Winter War and force the Soviet Union to capitulate.
Guess who's back - As Mongolia, restore Genden to power after he is imprisoned.
And many more achievements are on their way!

Off-course all of these being said, the mod is also lucky to have a dedicated Artist group that is working tirelessly and around to clock to provide the highest quality of icons in any form possible. From portraits to focus icons, the mod takes the benefits of the Vanilla style, and improves upon them, from attempting new techniques and sometimes overcoming the vanilla style in certain ways. Road to 56 was originally a released as a ‘mod pack’ in December of 2016 that contained Greatexperiments personal mods and some of the communities’ most popular country-specific mods at the time. It was operated from December 2016 till the Fall of 2018 as a ‘mod-pack.’ During this time Thinking_Waffle joined the development team, having previously developed a stand-alone country mod that was included in Road to 56. JudgeAlfred joined the mod team during this period as well. The mod would periodically update its content from the outside mods that comprised the mod pack and doing maintenance to make sure the content worked well together. This period of the mod’s life is known as ‘old-school’ or ‘legacy’ Road to 56. This is the period of time where the stigma’s of the mod being horrible unbalance and buggy took root because admittedly it was. Starting in the fall of 2018, the mod saw a large influx of new developers and artists who would help set the new course for the mod. As in the fall of 2018, the development team decided to stop updating the mod with outside content, and the last update that included content that was made outside the internal development team occurred in March 2019. From the fall of 2018 onward, the internal development team made new content in-house for the mod and work tirelessly to bring old content within the mod up to the communities’ high standards. This work has accumulated in Road to 56 becoming the most played Hearts of Iron 4 mod as well as the most subscribed to item on it’s the Hoi4 steam workshop. The hard work and hours spent on the mod was recognized when during PDXCON 2019 Thinking_Waffle stepped on stage to accept the 'Outstanding Modding Achievement' for the Road to 56 team.
